notes.title: 🎲 The Game Begins... Revolver Gambit is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.content:
[p]Revolver Gambit is officially live on Steam in Early Access!

 This is no ordinary game — it’s a slow-burning psychological standoff where every round is a gamble and every move could be your last. Outsmart your opponent, bluff, double-bluff, or pull the trigger — but only one player walks away.
[/p][p]🖤 A high-stakes duel – test your wits in noir-inspired face-offs against players or AI.
 🧠 Every decision counts – bluff, read your rival, survive the round.
 🌑 Elegant minimalism – stylized visuals and chilling silence turn tension into art.[/p][p]🎥 Join us on launch day for a special behind-the-scenes dive into the game's creation and design choices.
 🛒 Play now and help shape the future of Revolver Gambit — your seat at the table is waiting.[/p]
